alerts.title: Carbamazepine and DTG Interaction
alerts.message: Guidelines state that carbamazepine decreases DTG levels by 30-70%. Patient is on DTG and recently started carbamazepine, with a detectable viral load of 1240 copies/mL. This interaction may be contributing to the viral load increase.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor viral load and consider alternative antiepileptic or ART regimen
